blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: She fell at his feet, and then she took up her son. A long time later, a man who lost his children at sea wrote a hymn, It Is Well with My Soul. Church, it is well is not something you say because everything is fine. It is what you say when you are holding on to God in the worst hour, and you will not let go. God does not promise every story ends like this one. But he can be trusted with the ones we carry upstairs.
